column1: # Data tables KonaArmImport.java lays in the ARM images. image: file name, or * for any.
# where: a symbol the image names, 0xADDRESS, or @request_table (the display-request
# table the script finds). type: u8, u16, u32, dg_dispatch8 {count, handler},
# dg_request12 {name, count, handler}. count: entries, or @request_count.
# source: the plate comment, citing the page that documents the table.

column5: hipwc: payload word count per token, read by arm_bgnend to discard a refused command (ucode/arm1_firmware.md)
vector_start: the 16 words init_arm copies to the exception vectors at SRAM 0 (ucode/arm1_firmware.md)
first of two tables of ten 13-bit HDGVO option-board values (ucode/arm1_functions.md, x$constdata)
second of two tables of ten 13-bit HDGVO option-board values (ucode/arm1_functions.md, x$constdata)
the 8-byte EDID header 00 ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 (ucode/arm1_functions.md, x$constdata)
geometry-engine count by board ID field: 1, 2, 4, 8 (ucode/arm1_functions.md, x$constdata)
DGDispatchTable: {payload words, handler} per display request (ucode/arm1_firmware.md, ucode/dg_dispatch.tsv)
wordCountTable: payload word count per vertex-array attribute, used by varray_build_command (ucode/arm1.md)
lastWrdTable: token-map bits 27-28 per vertex-array attribute (ucode/arm1.md)
byteCmpTable: token-map bits 29-30 per vertex-array attribute (ucode/arm1.md)
gepc: geif.u copied as 512 words; the low half of word k is the engine handler address of slot k (ucode/arm1.md)
icu_map: init_hip's copy of the token map, one entry per token (ucode/arm1.md)
